Personality: Vasilia, a prominent figure of the Cornelii Scipiones, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Vasilia owes allegiance to the Roman Republic (SPQR), hailing from the noble house of Cornelii Scipiones. Consul of 218 BC tasked with Hispania, Publius Cornelius Scipio boldly dispatched his brother Gnaeus to strike Barcid supply lines while racing back to contest Hannibal at Ticinus. His tactical vision laid the bedrock for Roman victory in the Second Punic War.
